title: QUIC RFC 9000 Maximum ACK Delay Alarm Slack Policy
purpose: Describe the bounded runtime policy that makes the local max_ack_delay default explicitly include expected alarm-firing delay.
design_summary: The runtime now centralizes the default local max_ack_delay in QuicMaxAckDelayPolicy. The default remains 25,000 microseconds for behavioral compatibility, but it is expressed as a 24,000-microsecond intentional ACK delay plus a 1,000-microsecond expected alarm-firing delay. Runtime ACK-delay scheduling continues to consume the composed local max_ack_delay value, either from local transport parameters when present or from the policy default when absent.
data_and_state_considerations: The policy is stateless and represented in microseconds because the existing runtime ACK-delay path and tests already operate on elapsed microsecond budgets. The composition helper saturates at ulong.MaxValue so extreme configured components cannot wrap into a smaller advertised delay budget.
edge_cases_and_constraints: The default local max_ack_delay remains 25 milliseconds to avoid changing existing ACK timing behavior.
The expected alarm-firing delay is explicit and non-zero in the default policy.
Explicit local max_ack_delay values that already include alarm slack are consumed unchanged by the ACK-delay timer path.
Composing large intentional-delay and alarm-delay components saturates rather than overflowing.
risks: This slice does not introduce a public max_ack_delay configuration API.
This slice does not change transport-parameter wire serialization or resolve broader unit-conversion questions outside the runtime's current microsecond ACK-delay model.
No parser, serializer, encoder, or decoder is introduced. Existing transport-parameter codec proof remains separate.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This design closes REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S18P2-0015 by making the runtime's local max_ack_delay default explicitly include expected alarm-firing delay and by proving the ACK-delay timer uses the composed value.
